name: stackdome
description: Deploy, observe, debug, and scale applications on Stackdome from Codex using the Stackdome CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy, observe, debug, and scale apps on Stackdome.
interface.longDescription: Work with Stackdome, an application-delivery platform, through its CLI. Author and validate a stackfile from the current repo, deploy it, and verify the release actually converged and is healthy. Then operate it: tail runtime logs, triage failed builds and unhealthy resources, scale replicas, manage secrets and environment variables, provision Postgres addons and volumes, inspect and roll back releases, and tear a stack down safely.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this repo to my Stackdome instance.
Check the status of my stack.
Scale the web resource to three replicas.
